G4f2fd80b594d.what: warrant/engine.py View.accepted_at: COMPARE p < out[actor] -> p <= out[actor]
G4f2fd80b594d.reason: A position is (at, rank, record id), so two acceptance records never share one: p == out[actor] has no input, and < and <= keep the same earliest acceptance. SPEC-CLAIMS.md records the same fact for SPEC-4.2-10 ("two items never share an admission position").

G89a8d182adec.what: warrant/jcs.py _float: DELETE raise NotCanonical("floats are not admitted") -> pass
G89a8d182adec.reason: Without the raise, parse_float returns None, so the parsed value holds null where the bytes hold a number; canon(value) then differs from the raw bytes and loads refuses them as not canonical. Every float is refused either way; only the message differs (records_test E2 reads 1.5, 2.0 and 1e2).
